supported_devices_note: This adapter only supports Bluetooth trackers (devices on the "Find My Device" network, e.g. Chipolo, Pebblebee). Phones, tablets and other devices linked to the same Google account are deliberately NOT shown here - Google provides no usable location data for them through this API, and phone location would require a completely different, less secure access method (a full browser session instead of a narrowly-scoped token). Keep using Google's own interface at google.com/android/find for those.
setup_intro: This adapter needs a one-time login to your Google account. No password is entered here - only a short-lived token you copy out of your own browser.
setup_step2: Step 2: Don't log in yet. First open your browser's developer tools (F12), then the "Application" tab → "Cookies" → select "https://accounts.google.com". The list is still empty - that's normal, it fills in once you log in. Leave this developer tools window open.
setup_step3: Step 3: Now, in the other tab, log in with the Google account your trackers are linked to (including two-factor confirmation if enabled). The page may look empty afterwards, or get stuck on something like "I agree" and not proceed further - that's normal (it isn't meant for humans), the token is already valid at that point. Just continue with step 4.
setup_step4: Step 4: Switch back to the (already open) developer tools right away and refresh the cookie list if needed (small circular icon) until the row named "oauth_token" appears.
setup_step5: Step 5: Copy the full value of "oauth_token", paste it into the field below and save this configuration.
setup_warning: The oauth_token value only stays valid for a short time - do steps 3-5 in quick succession (step 2 can be done beforehand without rushing).
oauth_token_help: Paste the value here, then save. It will be exchanged for a long-lived token and cleared automatically.
poll_interval_help: How often to fetch tracker locations from Google.
step2_intro: One more manual step is needed to decrypt actual coordinates (device names already work without this). Check this adapter instance's log after it restarts for a link to open and a small script to paste into your browser's developer console there - both are logged once this point is reached. Complete whatever Google asks for on that page, then paste the result it shows you into the field below and save.
shared_key_json_help: Paste the captured text here, then save. It will be exchanged for the decryption key and cleared automatically.
step2_done: Location decryption is set up - coordinates will appear as states on the next poll.
device_settings_intro: Actively requesting a location makes the tracker send a short Bluetooth burst - this noticeably drains its battery. Please enable this individually per tracker and pick an interval that fits the device (e.g. rarely for a bike that mostly sits at home). Newly found trackers are added here automatically, but disabled by default. Phones/tablets from the same Google account deliberately don't show up here (see the note above).
